assessment: This paper is of interest to readers in the fields of DNA repair, DNA-protein interactions, and those employing single-molecule techniques. Using single-molecule methods, the authors visualized how RecX, a negative regulator of homologous recombination in bacteria, interferes with the active species in recombination, the RecA nucleoprotein filament. They showed that RecX binds to the RecA filament in its post-ATP hydrolysis state, promotes RecA dissociation from ssDNA, and causes a reversible conformational change of the filament. The latter mode of RecX action is novel and of particular interest. The authors present an interesting model of the RecX-RecA-ATP-ssDNA system.
